story.title: Why we build
body: NeoByte Technology was founded by engineers who wanted to build real systems, not presentations. From the start, the goal was simple: take on hard problems and ship working software that solves them.

We are rooted in Burkina Faso, with direct exposure to global technology ecosystems — from AI research communities to China's manufacturing and commerce networks. That position shapes what we build: technology adapted to the realities of emerging markets, engineered to international standards.

We develop our own products because building for real users is the best engineering discipline there is. Products like Yawoto and Barkosem came out of problems we saw firsthand — and everything we learn from running them goes back into the systems we build for organizations.

geo.title: Built from Africa. Connected to global technology.
geo.body: Our roots are in Africa; our engineering connects to technology ecosystems around the world. We build locally grounded systems to global standards.

items.description: A demo proves nothing. We build systems that run in the real world, with real users and real data.

items.title: Measure by real usage

introduction.title: 1.1 Introduction
introduction.body: This Privacy Policy describes how NeoByte Technology ("NeoByte", "we", "our", or "us") collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information when you use our websites, mobile applications (including applications distributed through the Apple App Store), software, and related services (collectively, the "Services"). By accessing or using the Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy. This Policy is designed to comply with applicable data protection laws and with the requirements of the Apple Developer Program and the App Store Review Guidelines.

collection.title: 1.2 Information We Collect
collection.intro: We collect only the information necessary to provide, secure, and improve the Services:
items: Information you provide: name, email address, phone number, company details, account credentials, and the content of your inquiries or support requests.
Technical and usage data: IP address, device model, operating system version, browser type, application version, usage logs, and diagnostic or crash data.
Project and business data: files, documents, and system configurations you share with us in the context of software development or service delivery.

Payment data: purchases made within our mobile applications are processed by Apple through the App Store; we do not collect or store your payment card details. For other services, billing information is processed by secure third-party payment providers.

use.title: 1.3 How We Use Your Information
use.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide, operate, and maintain the Services.
Process transactions and deliver purchased features, content, or subscriptions.
Optimize performance, diagnose technical issues, and improve the user experience.
Respond to support requests and send service-related communications.
Ensure security, prevent fraud and abuse, and comply with our legal obligations.

sharing.title: 1.4 Data Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share information only in the following circumstances:
items: With authorized employees and subcontractors bound by confidentiality obligations.
With trusted third-party providers that support hosting, analytics, payment processing, or infrastructure, subject to appropriate data protection safeguards.
With Apple, to the extent required for the operation, review, or distribution of our applications on the App Store.
With public authorities when required by applicable law or to protect our legal rights.

retention.title: 1.5 Data Retention
retention.body: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, to comply with legal, accounting, or reporting obligations, or to resolve disputes. When data is no longer required, it is securely deleted or anonymized.

security.title: 1.6 Data Security
security.body: We implement industry-standard technical and organizational measures, including encryption in transit, access controls, and secure development practices, to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we continuously work to strengthen our safeguards.

rights.title: 1.7 Your Rights and Choices
rights.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may exercise the following rights by contacting us at contact@neobytech.net. We respond to verified requests within the timeframes required by applicable law:
items: Access, correct, or request the deletion of your personal information.
Request a portable copy of your data.
Withdraw your consent to specific processing activities at any time.
Object to or request the restriction of certain processing.
Delete your account and associated data.

children.title: 1.8 Children's Privacy
children.body: The Services are not directed to children under the age of 13 (or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will promptly delete it.

transfers.title: 1.9 International Data Transfers
transfers.body: Your information may be processed in countries other than your own, where data protection laws may differ. Where required, we apply appropriate safeguards to ensure your information remains protected in accordance with this Policy.

changes.title: 1.10 Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be announced by posting the updated Policy on this page with a revised "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the Services after the changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

introduction.title: 3.1 Introduction
introduction.body: This Cookie Policy explains how NeoByte Technology uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on its websites and digital platforms, and the choices available to you regarding their use.

what.title: 3.2 What Are Cookies?
what.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to function properly, remember your preferences, and help us understand how the site is used.

types.title: 3.3 Types of Cookies We Use
items: Strictly necessary cookies: required for the operation, authentication, and security of the website. These cannot be disabled.
Analytics cookies: used to measure audience, performance, and user interactions in an aggregated manner.
Preference cookies: used to remember your settings, such as language and display preferences.
Third-party cookies: set by external service providers (for example, analytics or embedded tools) under their own privacy policies.

use.title: 3.4 How We Use Cookies
items: Ensure the proper functioning of the website and the security of your sessions.
Improve the performance and reliability of the website.
Analyze traffic and usage patterns to improve our Services.
Remember your preferences and personalize your experience.

managing.title: 3.5 Managing Cookies
managing.body: You can configure or disable cookies at any time through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies, particularly strictly necessary cookies, may affect the functionality of the website and limit access to some features.

updates.title: 3.6 Updates to This Policy
updates.body: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect technical or legal developments. Changes take effect upon publication on this page.
